items.title: 电影质感肖像
items.description: 暖色调电影感单人肖像，浅景深 + 柔光。
items.prompt: A cinematic close-up portrait of a young Asian woman, soft warm rim light, shallow depth of field, 35mm film grain, melancholic golden hour mood, photographed on Kodak Portra 400, painterly skin tones.

items.title: 极简产品发布海报
items.description: 新品发布海报，瑞士风排版 + 留白。
items.prompt: Minimalist product launch poster, Swiss typographic style, generous white space, single bold sans-serif headline 'NEXT', subtle muted teal accent, square 1:1 layout, print quality.

items.title: 扁平风插画
items.description: 几何扁平插画，柔和配色。
items.prompt: Flat geometric illustration of a person reading under a tree in a city park, soft pastel palette of sage green / cream / dusty pink, no gradients, clean vector look, balanced composition, vertical 2:3.

items.title: 进化对比信息图
items.description: 横向 3 步进化对比，配淡灰背景与图标。
items.prompt: Editorial infographic showing a 3-step evolution of a smartphone form factor, horizontal layout, isometric flat icons, subtle drop shadows, light gray background, annotated with concise typography in dark blue, clean grid alignment.

items.title: 3D 产品渲染
items.description: 柔光摄影棚 3D 产品 mock。
items.prompt: 3D studio render of a minimalist wireless earbud charging case on a pastel pink pedestal, soft top-down studio lighting, glossy reflections, ultra-clean background, hyperrealistic materials, 35mm equivalent lens look.

items.title: 动漫风景
items.description: 夏日午后的乡村小路，新海诚式光感。
items.prompt: Anime landscape illustration of a quiet countryside path in late summer, towering cumulus clouds, glowing afternoon sun, dappled green rice fields, lush detailed foliage, Makoto Shinkai inspired lighting, cinematic 16:9.

items.title: 流体抽象
items.description: 高饱和度流体波纹，纸质纹理叠加。
items.prompt: Abstract fluid art composition, undulating waves of saturated magenta, gold and deep teal, marbled ink texture, subtle paper grain overlay, vertical balanced composition, fine art print quality.

items.title: 3x3 头像合集
items.description: 九宫格头像合集，统一光影与色调。
items.prompt: 3x3 grid collage of nine portrait avatars of diverse young adults, consistent soft studio lighting, neutral pastel backdrops varying per cell, head-and-shoulders framing, friendly expressions, illustration meets photography hybrid style.
